title: Brotherhood and Sisterhood
definition: Brotherhood and sisterhood describe the spiritual family relationship believers share as brothers and sisters in Christ.
summary: Believers are not strangers or competitors, but members of one family under one Father. This calls for love, honor, patience, forgiveness, service, and care.
christFocus: Christ makes believers one family through His blood and teaches them to love one another as His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers are not strangers or competitors, but members of one family under one Father. This calls for love, honor, patience, forgiveness, service, and care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
